mapper.sql:
FROM journal_entry j
AND (j.title LIKE #{query.likePattern} ESCAPE '!' OR j.content_md LIKE #{query.likePattern} ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entry_tag jt JOIN tag t ON t.id = jt.tag_id WHERE jt.journal_entry_id = j.id AND t.name LIKE #{query.likePattern} ESCAPE '!'))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entry_tag filter_tag WHERE filter_tag.journal_entry_id = j.id AND filter_tag.tag_id = #{query.tagId})

FROM knowledge_item k
AND (k.title LIKE #{query.likePattern} ESCAPE '!' OR k.content_md LIKE #{query.likePattern} ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_item_tag kt JOIN tag t ON t.id = kt.tag_id WHERE kt.knowledge_item_id = k.id AND t.name LIKE #{query.likePattern} ESCAPE '!'))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_item_tag filter_tag WHERE filter_tag.knowledge_item_id = k.id AND filter_tag.tag_id = #{query.tagId})

sql.if: SELECT 'JOURNAL' AS source_type, j.id AS source_id, j.title, j.content_md, j.updated_at
SELECT 'KNOWLEDGE' AS source_type, k.id AS source_id, k.title, k.content_md, k.updated_at

mapper.select: SELECT source_type, source_id, title, content_md, updated_at FROM () results ORDER BY updated_at DESC, source_type ASC, source_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
